en.headline: MTR sends trains for inspection after passengers report odors on two lines
en.dek: Staff found no smell after passengers on the Tsuen Wan and Tuen Ma lines said they felt unwell around 9 p.m. on Friday, and the company has reported the matter to police.
body: The MTR Corporation said it received reports from passengers at Yau Ma Tei Station on the Tsuen Wan Line and To Kwa Wan Station on the Tuen Ma Line around 9 p.m. on Friday that the trains they were on had an odor, with some people reporting mild discomfort.

Staff boarded the trains to check but found no odor, and assisted the affected passengers, who continued their journeys. As a precaution, the operations control centre arranged for the relevant trains to return to the depot for inspection.
The company has reported the incident to police, who are treating it as a miscellaneous case. No further details on the cause have been released.

zh.headline: 港鐵接獲乘客反映列車異味 已安排列車返廠檢查並報警
zh.dek: 昨晚約9時，荃灣線油麻地站及屯馬線土瓜灣站有乘客反映列車有異味，部分人輕微不適，職員未發現異味，港鐵已報警。
body: 港鐵公司表示，昨晚約9時許，油麻地站及土瓜灣站分別收到乘客反映，所乘搭的荃灣線及屯馬線列車有異味，部分人表示輕微不適。
港鐵人員隨即上車跟進，未有發現異味，並向相關乘客提供協助，乘客其後繼續行程。為審慎起見，車務控制中心已安排相關列車返回車廠檢查。
港鐵已就事件報警，警方列作「雜項」處理。事件原因仍有待進一步了解。
